comment: CI shard map for the e2e job (parallel: 8). Each entry lists the feature FILES one shard runs (comma-separated, relative to the codecept dir, consumed via TASK_CODECEPTJS_FEATURES); check:shard-coverage enforces that every feature file lands in exactly one shard. Balanced on measured CI durations: the two long single stories ride alone (1, 2) and bound the pipeline wall-clock; the MegaLinter-hungry pair shares shard 7 so its image pull is paid once and both run concurrently.
